projects.title: Data Catalog
projects.with: Inspire Brands (Arby’s, Baskin-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, Sonic)
projects.context: Built for 500+ users · Snowflake, Power BI, SQL, Tableau
projects.description: The Data Intelligence Hub gives Inspire Brands one standardized place to find, understand and trust its data, built on Alation for 500+ users across the family of restaurant brands. As program manager, I led the team that built this online portal for Inspire employees, including the connections to Snowflake and Power BI, a process for curating data assets, and the creative assets across the site. I also helped lead the rollout across the company, partnering with Inspire’s corporate communications team on promotional material to spread the word about the platform.

projects.title: Interactive 360 TASER Training
projects.type: Interactive 360° VR training, built in Unity
projects.context: Deployed to 1,000+ agencies · Filmed in Poland and Los Angeles
projects.description: Immersive police training scenarios that put the trainee inside real 360° footage, with interaction layered on in Unity. I saw this project through every stage, from pitch to deployment. Once we secured $750K in funding, I directed and produced a proof of concept that became a product deployed to more than 1,000 agencies. That meant planning each scene from overhead blocking diagrams, directing on set during shoots in Poland and Los Angeles, and running the final tech review and iteration in Unity.

projects.description: Realistic TASER and movement modules for VR training. I managed the dev teams building them, balancing hardware constraints against detailed feedback from subject-matter experts.

projects.title: Road Code

projects.title: ALA
projects.description: An open-world interactive documentary about my grandmother’s life in 1950s Puerto Rico, exploring FBI surveillance, mass sterilization and cultural memory. I programmed the entire experience in Unity, using depth-mapped archival photos and immersive rooms to guide visitors through her world, with original audio recorded between three generations of my family.

projects.title: A Father Is Persevering
projects.type: 360° film with TiltBrush animation in Unity
projects.context: Advocating an end to mandatory minimums
projects.description: A collaborative 360° film created alongside an incarcerated father, advocating for an end to mandatory minimums. I co-led interviews, taught 360 filming and developed ways to animate TiltBrush art inside Unity, putting technical experimentation in service of human connection and justice reform.

projects.title: LEN1
projects.type: AI and VR installation, GPT-2, built in ShapeLab
projects.description: A speculative exploration of digital privacy and self-representation. I trained a GPT-2 model on my personal text history, creating an AI “Lawrence” inside a virtual home designed in VR. Visitors could ask it intimate or embarrassing questions while exploring a space built entirely in ShapeLab.

projects.title: Film School Simulator
